purpose: Prevent a new prospective hidden-memory test from being interpreted as a strong biological falsification when its frozen permutation design cannot cross alpha=0.05 for a point effect as large as the independently observed Schistanthe prospective effect.

scope.applies_only_to: future hidden-memory systems whose candidate-specific test and outcome have not already been frozen before this rule

empirical_reference.reference_role: informativeness benchmark, not a minimum biologically meaningful effect

sequence_before_observed_auc: freeze candidate-specific hierarchy, tree rule, crosswalk rule, support thresholds, estimator, null and PASS rule
open only the already-permitted state-support layer and determine compression opportunity
if there is no compression opportunity, stop at the candidate's structural no-opportunity terminal
construct the frozen same-coarse pair universe and negative-patristic-distance score ranks
generate the within-coarse fine-label permutation null without computing the observed fine-label AUC
compute null mean, one-sided alpha=0.05 AUC critical value and centered critical effect
only if the informativeness gate passes may the observed fine-label AUC be opened and the candidate-specific prospective PASS/FAIL rule evaluated

null_informativeness_calculation.null: permute fine-state labels within each frozen coarse-state group, preserving fine-state counts and coarse membership
null_informativeness_calculation.score: negative patristic distance on the frozen same-coarse pair universe
null_informativeness_calculation.critical_auc: 0.95 quantile of the permutation-null AUC distribution using the frozen implementation

interpretation_boundary: This is not a power analysis because it does not specify or simulate an alternative-effect distribution.
Passing means only that a point effect equal to the Schistanthe observed centered effect lies beyond the frozen null 5% critical threshold.
Passing does not guarantee detection probability, replication, or biological effect size.
Failing the informativeness gate is a structural information HOLD, not evidence against hidden memory.
No threshold may be relaxed after the candidate's observed AUC is opened.
